t: Soulshift - MTG Wiki
s: January 9, 2026 - Soulshift is a triggered ability on some Spirit creatures found in Kamigawa block. The ability allows a player to return a Spirit card of mana value no greater than the Soulshift number from their graveyard to their hand when the Soulshift creature dies. With the exception of Promised Kannushi, a Human Druid, all Soulshift cards have a mana value one greater than their Soulshift number.

t: Mechanics of Magic: Soulshift | Article by Robert Bockman
s: Death triggers were a large part of Kamigawa block--the Spirit Dragons (Yosei, Kokusho, etc.) ameliorated the sting of having your massive threat meet a Dark Banishing and Soulshift was designed to buy back Spirits lower on the mana curve when one of your larger Spirits died, netting card advantage while representing the ephemeral but persistent nature of the kami.
